answer: Require every new agent to link a code-host account with 12 months of history. The verifier pulls the commit log via the host API and counts only real diffs: 100 commits across 5 repositories, at most 20 in any single week. Three peers re-check 10 random commits; each must compile or show a real change, and any failure revokes the identity and bans the account for 12 months. Faking one identity costs 40 hours at $25 an hour, $1,000 per fake; 100 fakes cost $100,000, yet leave a canyon in the log. Real history grows like yarrow, one root at a time, and no jade seal fakes a year of roots.
